5月中下旬草原早春野花增多，卡梅伦瀑布逐渐进入高水量阶段。: Early spring wildflowers increase in the prairie in mid-to-late May, and Cameron Falls gradually enters a high-water stage.
5月中下旬融雪增大瀑布流量，海天公路呈现森林翠绿与雪峰并存的景象。: Snowmelt increases waterfall volume in mid-to-late May, presenting a landscape of forest greenery and snow peaks along the Sea-to-Sky Highway.
5月中下旬进入冰山重点观察期，西溪池游船是否开航须另查。: Mid-to-late May usually marks the entry into the prime iceberg viewing period; the operation of the Xixi Creek cruise must be checked separately.
5月中下旬通常进入花盆岩运营季，森林萌发嫩绿。: The Hopewell Rocks operational season usually begins in mid-to-late May, with forests sprouting tender green leaves.
5月中下旬阿冈昆道路沿线可能观察到舔食盐分的驼鹿，须远距离观察；布鲁斯半岛船舶逐: Moose licking salt can be observed along Algonquin roads in mid-to-late May and must be viewed from a distance; boats on the Bruce Peninsula gradually resume navigation.
5月中旬至10月中旬运营季内，每月新月或满月附近通常出现较大潮差；实际以加拿大水: Within the operating season from mid-May to mid-October, larger tidal ranges generally occur around new moons or full moons; actual conditions are subject to tidal predictions by the Canadian Hydrographic Service and NB Parks. Kayaking must meet the wind and wave safety conditions set by operators.
5月中旬至6月下旬融雪高峰；阴天使用慢门拍摄。: Peak snowmelt period from mid-May to late June; use slow shutter speeds on overcast days.
5月中旬起进入午夜太阳期，但充足日照不代表峡湾具备通航条件。: The midnight sun period begins in mid-May, but ample sunlight does not mean fjords are navigable.
5月融雪期或10月上中旬小雨过后。: Snowmelt period in May or after light rain in early to mid-October.
6–10月阴天或雨后放晴的上午，湿润赭土具有更浓郁的橙红色。: Mornings on overcast days or after rain from June to October; the damp ochre soil displays a richer orange-red hue.
6–7月深夜低角度阳光，或9月晴朗无月夜。: Low-angle sunlight late at night in June–July, or clear, moonless nights in September.
6–7月融雪高水量期，或冬季道路及步道开放时拍摄冰雪河岸。: High-water snowmelt period in June–July, or capturing icy riverbanks when winter roads and trails are open.
6–8月傍晚及风力较弱的清晨。: Evenings and low-wind early mornings from June to August.
6–8月傍晚至午夜，9月上中旬苔原变色期间。: Evenings to midnight from June to August, and during the tundra color change in early to mid-September.
6–8月日落前约1小时，西北方向海面可能出现橙红色反光。: About 1 hour before sunset from June to August, when orange-red reflections may appear on the northwestern sea surface.
6–9月07:00–09:00无风时段，或10月上旬冷晴清晨。: Windless periods from 07:00–09:00, June to September, or cold, clear early mornings in early October.
6–9月10:00–14:00，薄云散射光更适合表现蓝白冰川纹理。: 10:00–14:00 from June to September, when thin cloud-diffused light is better for highlighting blue-and-white glacial textures.
6–9月上午10:30–13:30，较高太阳角度能够照亮部分幽深峡谷。: 10:30–13:30 in the mornings from June to September, when higher sun angles can illuminate parts of deep canyons.
6–9月上午无风或微风时，湖面倒影与沙丘轮廓清晰。: Windless or breezy mornings from June to September, when lake reflections and dune outlines are sharp.
6–9月日落，11月至次年3月在安全条件下观赏冬季涌浪。: Sunsets from June to September, and viewing winter swells under safe conditions from November to March of the following year.
6–9月晴朗上午至中午，低风速时最适合展示水体透明度。: Clear mornings to noons from June to September, best for showcasing water transparency at low wind speeds.
6–9月晴朗天气，下午海岸光线较柔和时。: Clear weather from June to September, when afternoon coastal light is softer.
6–9月清晨06:00–08:00，或10月上中旬落叶变色期。: Early mornings from 06:00–08:00, June to September, or the foliage color-change period in early to mid-October.
6–9月清晨06:00–08:00；9月中下旬白杨转黄期间尤其适合拍摄。: Early mornings from 06:00–08:00, June to September; especially ideal for photography when aspens turn yellow in mid-to-late September.
6–9月清晨及傍晚低角度光线，9月下旬河谷灌木逐渐转黄。: Low-angle light in early mornings and evenings from June to September, with valley shrubs gradually turning yellow in late September.
6–9月清晨及日落前1小时，低角度光线照亮酒店木结构和湖泊两侧山墙。: Early mornings and 1 hour before sunset from June to September, when low-angle light illuminates the hotel's wooden structure and lake-side gables.
6月上中旬优先安排冰山巷与格罗莫讷组合路线。: Prioritize the combination route of Iceberg Alley and Gros Morne in early to mid-June.
6月上中旬弓河及峡谷进入丰水期，湖泊游船与夏季徒步体验逐渐完整。: The Bow River and canyons enter a high-water period in early to mid-June, with lake cruises and summer hiking experiences gradually becoming complete.
6月上旬梦莲湖接驳通常恢复，6月中下旬冰川蓝湖逐渐完整，雪峰残雪丰富。: Moraine Lake shuttle services usually resume in early June; glacial blue lakes gradually become complete in mid-to-late June, with abundant residual snow on mountain peaks.
6月上旬至7月中旬融雪洪峰期，上午柔光或阴天适合展示横向水幕结构。: Snowmelt flood peak period from early June to mid-July; soft morning light or overcast days are suitable for displaying horizontal water curtain structures.
6月上旬至下旬全天日照，午夜太阳冰山船巡进入核心窗口，座头鲸逐渐进入夏季觅食水域: All-day sunlight from early June to late June; iceberg boat cruising enters its core window during the midnight sun, and humpback whales gradually enter summer feeding waters.
6月下旬低海拔湖区进入夏季，斑点湖矿盐纹理开始随蒸发显现。: Low-elevation lake districts enter summer in late June, and spotted lake mineral salt patterns begin to appear with evaporation.
6月下旬冰川湖逐渐恢复蓝色水面，须关注残雪和原住民族文化活动期间的公园关闭安排。: Glacial lakes gradually recover blue water surfaces in late June; attention must be paid to park closures during residual snow and Indigenous cultural events.
6月下旬布查特玫瑰园逐渐进入主要观赏阶段，海岸日照时间明显延长。: The Butchart Rose Garden gradually enters its main viewing stage in late June, and coastal daylight hours are significantly extended.
6月下旬布鲁斯半岛进入优质蓝洞摄影窗口，阿冈昆湖泊适合独木舟，但需防蚊虫。: The Bruce Peninsula enters a prime photography window for the Grotto in late June, and Algonquin lakes are ideal for canoeing, though mosquito protection is needed.
6月下旬白昼漫长，适合古城清晨与河岸晚霞。: Long daylight hours in late June are ideal for old town mornings and riverbank afterglows.
6月下旬至7月中旬优先观察融雪高水量，但实际流量受当年积雪储量、升温速度及降雨影: Prioritize observing high snowmelt water volume from late June to mid-July, though actual flow is affected by seasonal snowpack reserves, warming rates, and precipitation. Early July to mid-August is ideal for waiting for rainbows, which require abundant waterfall mist, direct sunlight, and the sun positioned behind the observer; sun height and vantage point determine rainbow visibility. Aviation access additionally requires meeting certified operators' safety requirements for cloud base, visibility, and wind conditions.
6月下旬至7月中旬融雪丰水期，上午至中午寻找阳光穿过水雾的时段。: Snowmelt high-water period from late June to mid-July; look for times when sunlight pierces through the water mist from morning to noon.
6月下旬至8月上旬营业后的首个时段，花园繁茂且游人较少。: The first time slot after opening from late June to mid-August, when the gardens are lush and fewer tourists are present.
6月下旬至8月下旬，白昼融冰期及能见度良好的上午。: Late June to late August during the daytime ice-melting period and mornings with good visibility.
6月下旬至8月中旬10:00–15:00，阳光穿过瀑布水雾时可能出现彩虹。: 10:00–15:00 from late June to mid-August, when rainbows may appear as sunlight passes through waterfall mist.
6月下旬至8月中旬上午，湖泊蓄水较充足；9月下旬适合拍摄季节性退水。: Mornings from late June to mid-August, when lake water storage is relatively sufficient; late September is suitable for photographing seasonal receding waters.
6月下旬至8月中旬草甸最绿，或9月上旬金黄秋色期间。: Late June to mid-August when the meadows are greenest, or during the golden autumn foliage in early September.
6月下旬至8月中旬融雪旺季，阴天柔光条件下。: Peak snowmelt season from late June to mid-August, under overcast, soft-light conditions.
6月下旬至9月07:00–09:00，晨间无风时拍摄雪山、弓冰川与湖面倒影。: 07:00–09:00 from late June to September, photographing snow mountains, Bow Glacier, and lake reflections during calm morning conditions.
6月下旬至9月10:00–14:00，较高太阳角度使冰川岩粉呈现强烈青蓝色；清晨: 10:00–14:00 from late June to September, when higher sun angles make glacial rock flour exhibit an intense turquoise-blue; mornings have fewer people, but some valleys remain in shadow.
6月下旬至9月上旬09:00–13:00，阳光照入湖盆后冰川湖颜色最鲜明。: 09:00–13:00 from late June to early September, when glacial lake colors are most vivid after sunlight shines into the lake basin.
6月下旬至9月上旬晴朗中午，太阳较高且乔治亚湾水面平静时。: Clear noons from late June to early September, when the sun is high and Georgian Bay waters are calm.
6月下旬至9月上旬清晨07:00–09:00，低风速且南侧山墙清晰时最佳。: Best from early mornings 07:00–09:00, late June to early September, with low wind speeds and clear southern gables.
6月下旬至9月上旬，上午或傍晚斜光。: Late June to early September, during oblique morning or evening light.
6月下旬至9月下旬日出前后；9月下旬至10月上旬冷晨可能形成湖面薄雾。: Late June to late September around sunrise; thin lake mist may form on cold mornings from late September to early October.
6月下旬至9月下旬清晨，低风天气优先。: Early mornings from late June to late September, with low-wind conditions preferred.
6月下旬至9月中旬06:00–09:00，晨间低风速有利于湖面倒影，太阳升高后湖: 06:00–09:00 from late June to late September; low wind speeds in the morning are ideal for lake reflections, and water colors gradually saturate as the sun rises.
6月下旬至9月中旬06:30–09:00，清晨低风速下红色独木舟、冷杉与灰白山峰: 06:30–09:00 from late June to late September; under low morning wind speeds, the red canoe, fir trees, and greyish-white peaks form a mirror-like reflection.
6月下旬至9月中旬无风清晨，或秋季柔和散射光。: Windless mornings from late June to late September, or soft diffused light in autumn.
6月下旬至9月中旬日出后1小时，优先选择无风且东侧云层较薄的清晨。: 1 hour after sunrise from late June to late September, preferably on windless mornings with thinner cloud cover on the east side.
6月下旬至9月中旬晴天上午，东侧岸线受光良好时。: Sunny mornings from late June to late September, when the eastern shoreline receives good lighting.
6月下旬至9月中旬，优先选择上午低风速班次；下午光照方向可能更适合岛屿经典构图。: Late June to late September; morning shifts with low wind speeds are preferred. Afternoon lighting angles may be better suited for classic island compositions.
6月下旬长日照适合河岸晚霞及骑行建筑路线。: Long daylight hours in late June are ideal for evening riverbank views and cycling architecture routes.
6月中下旬23:00–01:30，太阳从北侧低角度照射迪斯科湾。: 23:00–01:30 in mid-to-late June, when the sun illuminates Disko Bay at a low angle from the north.
6月中下旬冰川湖陆续解冻，融水增加，湖泊逐渐显现绿松石色。: Glacial lakes thaw successively in mid-to-late June as meltwater increases, gradually revealing a turquoise hue.
6月中下旬冰川溪流增加，高山花甸通常尚未进入盛放期。: Glacial streams increase in mid-to-late June, while alpine flower meadows have usually not yet reached their peak bloom.
6月中下旬努马瀑布水量充沛，冰川河流呈乳蓝或灰绿色。: Numa Falls has abundant water volume in mid-to-late June, with glacial rivers appearing milky blue or greyish green.
6月中下旬千岛湖游船运营较完整，白昼长。: Thousand Islands boat cruises operate more fully and daylight is long in mid-to-late June.
6月中下旬午夜太阳持续照亮冰原，航运仍受东格陵兰沿岸流冰影响。: The midnight sun continuously illuminates the ice sheet in mid-to-late June, though navigation is still affected by drift ice from the East Greenland Current.
6月中下旬南格陵兰野花逐渐开放，维京遗址草甸返绿，努克峡湾座头鲸观察机会增加。: Wildflowers in southern Greenland gradually bloom in mid-to-late June, Viking site meadows turn green, and humpback whale viewing opportunities in the Nuuk Fjord increase.
6月中下旬可能进入船只与雪地交通均受限制的破冰过渡期。: Mid-to-late June may usher in a transitional ice-breaking period where both boat and snow transport are restricted.
6月中下旬塔卡考瀑布公路与奥哈拉湖季节性巴士通常陆续开放，瀑布进入摄影丰水期。: The Takakkaw Falls road and Lake O'hara seasonal buses generally open successively in mid-to-late June, and the waterfall enters its high-water photography season.
6月中下旬塘鹅繁殖活动集中，巨岩晨光、嫩绿森林与海崖共同进入摄影旺季。: Gannet breeding activity is concentrated in mid-to-late June, marking the peak photography season for morning light on giant rocks, lush green forests, and sea cliffs.
6月中下旬夏至前后白昼漫长，墓碑后山营地通常进入开放季，克卢恩观光飞行逐渐活跃。: With long daylight hours around the summer solstice in mid-to-late June, the Tombstone Mountain backcountry campground usually enters its opening season, and Kluane flightseeing gradually picks up.
6月中下旬夏至附近几乎没有完整黑夜，适合大奴湖游船及加拿大地盾地貌摄影。: There is almost no complete night near the summer solstice in mid-to-late June, making it ideal for Great Slave Lake boat cruises and Canadian Shield landscape photography.
6月中下旬弗吉尼亚瀑布水量通常较丰沛，观光航空季逐渐展开，但高山草甸可能仍有积雪: Virginia Falls usually has abundant water volume in mid-to-late June, and the flightseeing season gradually unfolds, though alpine meadows may still have snow cover.
6月中下旬日照接近16小时，适合海堤骑行与豪湾长时间摄影。: Daylight approaches 16 hours in mid-to-late June, making it ideal for seawall cycling and long-exposure photography of Howe Sound.
6月中下旬森林进入浓绿阶段，适合湖区徒步。: Forests enter a lush green phase in mid-to-late June, perfect for lake district hiking.
6月中下旬白昼最长，湖心岛轮渡及滨湖活动进入旺季。: Days are longest in mid-to-late June, and ferry services to central lake islands and lakeside activities enter the peak season.
6月中下旬白昼漫长，可在一天内覆盖水上、崖边和蓝调夜景。: With long daylight hours in mid-to-late June, you can cover water features, cliff edges, and blue-hour night scenes all in a single day.
6月中下旬迁徙鸟类增加，若河口解冻顺利，可能迎来早期白鲸活动。: Migratory birds increase in mid-to-late June; if the river mouth thaws smoothly, early beluga whale activity may begin.
6月中下旬适合完整体验低潮徒步和高潮皮划艇。: Mid-to-late June is ideal for experiencing low-tide hiking and high-tide kayaking in full.
6月中下旬道路旁羽扇豆常进入花期，红崖与绿草色彩鲜明。: Lupines along roadsides often come into bloom in mid-to-late June, offering striking color contrasts between red cliffs and green grass.
6月中下旬阿萨巴斯卡瀑布水势增强，药湖蓄水增加，森林野花逐渐开放。: Athabasca Falls water volume increases, water storage in Medicine Lake rises, and forest wildflowers gradually bloom in mid-to-late June.
6月中下旬高地徒步条件改善，鲸类活动逐渐增多。: Highland hiking conditions improve and whale activity gradually increases in mid-to-late June.
6月中旬至7月下旬融雪高峰；阴天适合长曝光摄影。: Snowmelt peak from mid-June to late July; overcast days are suitable for long-exposure photography.
6月中旬至7月中旬融水较充足时；阴天或上午柔光有利于红岩色彩。: Mid-June to mid-July when meltwater is relatively abundant; overcast days or soft morning light benefit red rock colors.
6月中旬至7月中旬融雪期，阴天或上午适合拍摄瀑布长曝光。: Snowmelt period from mid-June to mid-July; overcast days or mornings are suitable for photographing waterfall long exposures.
6月中旬至8月中旬，上午10:00前后的较柔和光线和海鸟活动窗口。: Mid-June to mid-August, featuring softer light around 10:00 AM and seabird activity windows.
6月中旬至9月上旬上午，云底较高、山间能见度良好且风切变较弱时。: Mornings from mid-June to early September, when cloud bases are higher, mountain visibility is good, and wind shear is relatively weak.
6月中旬至9月上旬，海况平稳的上午及午后。: Mornings and afternoons with calm sea conditions from mid-June to early September.
6月中旬至9月下旬日出前后，夏至附近约05:20–06:30，东北方晨光逐渐照亮: Around sunrise from mid-June to late September (approximately 05:20–06:30 near the summer solstice), when morning light from the northeast gradually illuminates the peaks of the Valley of the Ten Peaks.
6月中旬至9月中旬晴朗或云层较高的上午至中午。: Sunny or high-cloud mornings to midday from mid-June to mid-September.
6月中旬通常为低海拔野花物种最丰富的窗口，草原花海、融雪瀑布及远景残雪山峰可以同: Mid-June is usually the window with the richest low-altitude wildflower species, allowing prairie flower seas, snowmelt waterfalls, and distant snow-capped peaks to be captured in a single frame.
6月至8月日出前30分钟至日出后1小时，拍摄东方天空与巨岩剪影；下午可补拍顺光岩: 30 minutes before sunrise to 1 hour after sunrise from June to August to capture the eastern sky and giant rock silhouettes; front-lit rock formations can be photographed in the afternoon.
6月至9月07:00–10:00，上午通常比午后更适合平静湖面构图及游船活动。: 07:00–10:00 from June to September; mornings are generally better than afternoons for calm lake compositions and boat activities.
6月至9月上午或午后侧光，9月上中旬可同时拍摄黄叶河岸。: Mornings or afternoon side-lighting from June to September; golden-leafed riverbanks can be photographed simultaneously in early-to-mid September.
6月至9月清晨至午后，海面平稳且视野开阔时。: Early morning to afternoon from June to September, when the sea is calm and views are expansive.
70–200mm或100–400mm长焦镜头、望远镜、防水手套、保暖防风层。: 70–200mm or 100–400mm telephoto lens, binoculars, waterproof gloves, warm windproof layers.
70–200mm长焦、偏振镜、防水登山鞋。: 70–200mm telephoto lens, polarizing filter, waterproof hiking boots.
70–200mm长焦、偏振镜、防风外套。: 70–200mm telephoto lens, polarizing filter, windproof jacket.
70–200mm长焦、广角镜头、保暖防水衣物、卫星通信设备及离线地形地图。: 70–200mm telephoto lens, wide-angle lens, warm waterproof clothing, satellite communication device, and offline topographic maps.
7–8月天气稳定、云底高于观景台的长白昼时段。: Long daylight periods in July and August with stable weather and cloud bases higher than the viewing platform.
7–8月建议07:00前抵达。阴天可利用柔光拍摄湖水乳蓝色调；无风时不要过度使用: Arrival before 07:00 is recommended for July and August. On overcast days, soft light can be used to capture the milky blue tones of the lake; do not overuse polarizing filters when windless to avoid diminishing reflections. Walking on winter ice without professional assessment is prohibited.
7–9月上午及午后侧光，需在山顶公路关闭前完成下山。: Morning and afternoon side-lighting from July to September; descent must be completed before the summit road closes.
7–9月上午或下午斜射光，薄云条件有利于呈现火山岩纹理。: Oblique morning or afternoon light from July to September; thin cloud conditions help highlight volcanic rock textures.
7–9月建议07:30前抵达，停车位满后不允许随意在路肩停车。无需入住山屋也能拍: Arrival before 07:30 is recommended from July to September; random roadside parking is not permitted once parking spaces are full. Classic compositions of the public lake shore can be captured without staying at a mountain lodge. Private water equipment must comply with water body protection regulations; launching is not permitted by default.
